The player have a radius of collision by 100 units.

Line 1: 1 integer x for the current x position of your player.

Line 4: 1 integer vy for the current vy velocity of your player.

Line 7: 1 integer haveball if your player have the ball.
Line 8: 1 integer nbut 1 if you score right , 2 if you score on left.
Line 9: 1 integer ox for the current x position of your player.
Line 10: 1 integer oy for the current y position of your player.
Line 11: 1 integer ovx for the current vx velocity of your player.
Line 12: 1 integer ovy for the current vy velocity of your player.
Line 13: 1 integer oradius for the current radius of your player.
Line 14: 1 integer othrust for the current thrust of your player.
Line 15: 1 integer ohaveball if your player have the ball.
Line 16: 1 integer onbut 1 if you score right , 2 if you score on left.
Line 17: 1 integer bx for the current x position of the ball.
Line 18: 1 integer by for the current y position of the ball.
Line 19: 1 integer bvx for the current vx velocity of the ball.
